registration: Local design frozen before running the pilot; not an external preregistration

historical_cohort.unit: game and configured participant; decisions are nested observations
historical_cohort.restriction: New baseline runs are not added to this cohort and cannot estimate historical LLM transfer

offline_pilot.purpose: Reference-policy and scenario-library quality audit, not a model ranking or skill benchmark
offline_pilot.winner_rule: Only engine-recorded termination supplies a winner; censored games have no imputed winner
offline_pilot.resolution: Stop on invalid generated action; never silently repair or apply fallback
offline_pilot.uncertainty: Descriptive only; two purpose-chosen seeds do not support population ranking or confidence intervals
offline_pilot.scenario_population: All JSON files in contracts/micro/scenarios at frozen source hashes

future_arms.target: Exact local endpoint attainment and action-value distributions under declared utility
future_arms.units: held-out source state, configured model, response replicate
future_arms.design: Group-split related states and source games; certify payment/building endpoints; independently evaluate plan quality and applied execution
future_arms.holdout: Prospectively authored states grouped away from published historical cases; freeze scoring before model output
future_arms.hypothesis: Executable endpoint attainment varies independently of a fluent explanation score
future_arms.decision_rule: Report valid action, achieved endpoint, encoding failure and unresolved cases separately
blocked_on: approved model roster and spending cap

future_arms.target: Improvement after feedback at a later comparable decision and transfer after an opponent-policy switch
future_arms.units: model-by-task sequence and independently randomized sequence replicate
future_arms.design: Randomize truthful feedback versus equally sized irrelevant feedback; retain identical task constraints; evaluate post-feedback and held-out transfer opportunities
future_arms.holdout: Hold out opponent-policy family and repeated-task template, not only surface wording
future_arms.hypothesis: Relevant feedback improves later target choices relative to control without increasing forbidden actions
future_arms.decision_rule: Estimate within-sequence improvement and treatment interaction; do not label a single correction as learning
blocked_on: explicit authorization for versioned feedback/memory treatment

future_arms.target: Performance and uncertainty across opponent compositions and independently sampled seeds
future_arms.units: independent game; seat rotations nested within a seed block
future_arms.design: Cross-play each focal configuration against validated policy mixtures and unfamiliar LLM opponents; rotate seats; randomize scheduling within treatment strata
future_arms.holdout: Reserve seeds and opponent policy families before result inspection
future_arms.hypothesis: A configuration ordering estimated on training opponents predicts held-out opponent performance
future_arms.decision_rule: Report wins, censoring and policy-specific outcomes; do not infer matched dice opportunities after action-dependent divergence
blocked_on: independent seed sampling and precision design

future_arms.target: Out-of-sample association of independently measured general capability with a defined multi-agent battery
future_arms.units: model configuration nested in family; repeated tasks and games supply outcome uncertainty
future_arms.design: Sample multiple tiers within several families; fix or factorially vary compute/resolution; measure general ability independently; hold out families or tiers for prediction
future_arms.holdout: Independent model/family holdout and independent task holdout
future_arms.hypothesis: Independent general capability predicts prespecified multi-agent outcomes beyond family and resource covariates
future_arms.decision_rule: Compare out-of-sample predictions with family/resource-only baselines; do not regress four heterogeneous names and call it a capability law
blocked_on: explicit authorization for new task conditions

future_arms.target: Effect of a specified disclosure/framing contrast on factual endorsement and action choice
future_arms.design: Randomize message variants while holding economic terms and delivered non-message facts fixed; randomize presentation order and check intervention validity
future_arms.hypothesis: The specified information manipulation changes recipient action or factual endorsement
future_arms.decision_rule: Separate acceptance, premise endorsement and realized payoff; do not infer intent from a treatment effect

paid_run_gate.rule: No provider adapter is implemented in this offline package; enabling a JSON flag must not enable model calls
